stories.title: 1 dead, 2 critically hurt in crash on southeast side of Indianapolis
stories.summary: According to IMPD, the crash happened just before 10:30 a.m. at South Emerson Avenue and Shelbyville Road.

stories.title: 'We tend to see people as family ' | Longtime downtown pizzeria plans to close
stories.summary: Giorgio's Pizza's co-owner said the decision mainly came down to a lease agreement, but other factors weighed in as well.

stories.title: Exclusive: ACLU of Indiana names new interim legal director as internal investigation continues
stories.summary: Lauren Robel will oversee the ACLU's legal work to protect rights for Hoosiers after staff shakeup.

stories.title: City of Muncie and AFSCME Union declare impasse in contract negotiations
stories.summary: Muncie has officially declared an impasse in negotiations with the American Federation of State, County, and Municipal Employees.

stories.title: Police: Jury duty scam, payment demand targets Fishers residents
stories.summary: "Scammers acting as police officers are contacting individuals, claiming they have missed jury duty and demanding payment," police said Wednesday.

stories.title: Georgia automotive group acquires Dreyer & Reinbold dealerships in Indianapolis, Greenwood
stories.summary: Dreyer & Reinbold's dealerships and real estate has been acquired by Five Star Automotive Group, a family-owned retailer in Macon, Georgia, reports said.

stories.title: ISP investigating death of incarcerated man who got out of moving transport van in Miami County
stories.summary: Justin Watts, 27, reportedly got out of a moving transport vehicle that was going to the Miami Correctional Facility Monday evening.

stories.title: Beckwith makes campaign committee change amid questions about future
stories.summary: On the day Republican Gov. Mike Braun announced his 2028 reelection bid without him, Lt. Gov. Micah Beckwith renamed his campaign finance committee.

stories.title: Santa to tour around Carmel alongside first responders this holiday season
stories.summary: ​Santa Claus is making stops in Carmel this holiday season ahead of Christmas alongside his first responder friends.

stories.title: Speedway drops eminent domain action targeting stalled hotel site across from IMS, but says it still seeks to acquire property
stories.summary: The town says in court filings it still intends to acquire the unfinished Wilshaw Hotel site, but must complete additional steps before moving forward.

stories.title: Keystone Group acquires BMO Tower in downtown Indianapolis
stories.summary: The tower is located at 135 North Pennsylvania Street, near Monument Circle.

stories.title: Carmel man charged with murder in fatal shooting of his wife
stories.summary: Carmel police said officers were called to a home in the 13900 block of Wildcat Drive shortly before 10:30 p.m. Nov. 12 on a report of shots fired.
